```yaml
name: Merge Queue Cleanup

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/5 * * * *'  # Runs every 5 minutes

jobs:
  cleanup-merge-queue:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install requests

      - name: Get list of unmergeable PRs
        id: get_unmergeable_prs
        run: |
          import requests
          response = requests.get('https://api.github.com/repos/nexi-lab/nexus/pulls?state=open&sort=created&direction=asc')
          prs = response.json()
          unmergeable_prs = [pr for pr in prs if pr['mergeable_state'] == 'unmergeable']
          print(f"::set-output name=unmergeable_prs::{','.join(str(pr['number']) for pr in unmergeable_prs)}")

      - name: Process each unmergeable PR
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          pr_number=$PR_NUMBER
          pr_url="https://github.com/nexi-lab/nexus/pull/$pr_number"
          pr_title=$(curl -s "$pr_url" | grep -oP '(?<="title": ")[^"]+')

          echo "Processing PR #$pr_number: $pr_title"

          # Post comment on PR
          curl -X POST \
            -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "{\"body\": \"This PR is currently marked as **UNMERGEABLE**. Please rebase your changes and push again to resolve conflicts. Once resolved, you can try merging it again.\"}" \
            "$pr_url/comments"

          # Request review from author
          curl -X PUT \
            -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "{\"reviewers\":[\"$GITHUB_ACTOR\"]}" \
            "$pr_url/requested_reviewers"
```
